stories.title: El «riesgo» asumido por Rosalía en 'Lux', premio Nacional de las Músicas Actuales

en.title: The 'risk' taken by Rosalía in 'Lux', National Award for Contemporary Music
en.summary: Rosalía received the National Award for Contemporary Music for her album 'Lux'. The award recognizes her artistic risk-taking and innovative approach to music, building on her previous work 'El mal querer' from 2018.

stories.title: Mónica García renuncia a liderar el Frente Amplio en favor de Ada Colau

en.title: Mónica García resigns from leading the Broad Front in favor of Ada Colau
en.summary: Mónica García has stepped down as the candidate to lead the Broad Front coalition for the general elections on November 29th. Ada Colau is being proposed as the presidential candidate instead.

stories.title: Más Madrid propone que Colau sea la candidata del Frente Amplio a la presidencia del Gobierno y encabece la lista en Barcelona

en.title: Más Madrid proposes that Colau be the Broad Front candidate for president and lead the list in Barcelona
en.summary: Más Madrid has proposed Ada Colau as the presidential candidate for the Broad Front coalition and as the lead candidate in Barcelona. Mónica García will head the list in Madrid.

stories.title: Yolanda Díaz quiere subir el salario mínimo antes de las elecciones

en.title: Yolanda Díaz wants to raise the minimum wage before the elections
en.summary: The Minister of Labor Yolanda Díaz is moving to increase the minimum wage before the November 29th general elections. She has convened experts to discuss the raise, which will later be submitted for consultation with unions and employers.

stories.title: La UCO confirma que la cloaca del PSOE contactó con los narcos para «eliminar» a la juez del caso del hermano de Sánchez: «A palos aprende el burro»

en.title: The UCO confirms that the PSOE's underground network contacted drug traffickers to "eliminate" the judge in Sánchez's brother's case: "The donkey learns by blows"
en.summary: Spain's Civil Guard operative unit reports that alleged underground networks within the PSOE made contact with drug traffickers from Badajoz to target Judge Beatriz Biedma, who was investigating a case against David Sánchez, the president's brother.

stories.title: Ada Colau, candidata oficiosa del Frente Amplio a las elecciones tras bajarse Mónica García de la pelea

en.title: Ada Colau, unofficial candidate of the Broad Front for elections after Mónica García withdraws from the race
en.summary: Más Madrid has yielded to pressure from its coalition partners, with Ada Colau emerging as the Broad Front's leading candidate, running on the Barcelona electoral list.

stories.title: Yolanda Díaz pisa el acelerador para aprobar una subida del SMI antes de las elecciones generales

en.title: Yolanda Díaz accelerates effort to approve minimum wage increase before general elections
en.summary: The labor minister is leading an advisory commission meeting to begin developing a report on updating the minimum wage reference for 2027.

stories.title: Colau será la candidata del Frente Amplio a la presidencia desde la lista de Barcelona

en.title: Colau will be the Broad Front's candidate for presidency from the Barcelona list
en.summary: The former Barcelona mayor's entry into the race brings Podemos closer to the Broad Front coalition.

stories.title: Trabajo da el primer paso para subir el salario mínimo antes de las elecciones generales

en.title: Labor Ministry takes first step to raise minimum wage before general elections
en.summary: Spain's Labor Ministry is convening an expert commission to recommend a new minimum wage figure, which is the preliminary step before negotiations with unions and business organizations.

stories.title: Rosalía, Premio Nacional de las Músicas Actuales 2026

en.title: Rosalía, National Prize for Contemporary Music 2026
en.summary: Rosalía has received the National Prize for Contemporary Music 2026, with the jury recognizing the artistic significance of her 2025 album 'LUX'.

stories.title: Rosalía, Premio Nacional de Músicas Actuales 2026

en.title: Rosalía, National Prize for Contemporary Music 2026
en.summary: Rosalía won the National Prize for Contemporary Music 2026, with the jury commending her latest album 'LUX' as an ambitious, innovative, and transformative musical proposal.

stories.title: Premio Nobel de Química para Henri Kagan y Kenso Soai por arrojar luz en el misterio de las asimetrías de la naturaleza

en.title: Nobel Prize in Chemistry awarded to Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai for shedding light on the mystery of natural asymmetries
en.summary: Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for explaining a molecular phenomenon central to pharmaceutical production and the thalidomide crisis.

stories.title: Sapa quintuplicó su beneficio neto en 2025 tras vender el 8,3% de Tess Defence a Indra por 33,74 millones

en.title: Sapa quintupled its net profit in 2025 after selling 8.3% of Tess Defence to Indra for 33.74 million
en.summary: Sapa significantly increased its net profit in 2025 through the sale of a stake in Tess Defence to Indra for approximately 33.74 million euros.

stories.title: El Ibex cae hasta los 19.100 puntos con la corrección de la banca

en.title: The Ibex falls to 19,100 points with banking correction
en.summary: Spain's stock index declined as banking stocks retreated amid rising oil prices above 100 dollars and government debt interest rates near highs, following an Indian rate increase.

stories.title: Un impuesto a los oligarcas de California transformaría a Estados Unidos

en.title: A tax on California's oligarchs would transform the United States
en.summary: Supporters of a proposed tax targeting wealthy individuals in California aim to achieve political objectives alongside budgetary effects.

stories.title: Telefónica amplía el patrocinio del O2 Arena en Londres por 230 millones

en.title: Telefónica extends O2 Arena sponsorship in London for 230 million
en.summary: Telefónica's subsidiary O2 will continue as naming rights holder for the London entertainment venue through 2038 at approximately 20 million pounds annually.

stories.title: ¿Durante cuánto tiempo más podrá el mundo absorber el shock de Irán?

en.title: How much longer can the world absorb the Iran shock?
en.summary: Global oil supply disruptions, crude prices, and the world economy have remained surprisingly manageable so far, raising questions about the sustainability of this situation.
